researched.description: AI recruitment, enrollment and campus operations platform for colleges and universities
researched.notes: Company site does not list HQ or founding year; Cambridge, MA and 2013 come from CB Insights/Tracxn-style profiles. Legal entity is Canopy Education, Inc. dba CollegeVine. Site now positions the product as an 'AI operating system for universities' spanning enrollment, financial aid, advancement and finance, broader than recruitment alone.

researched.description: ERP, student information and CRM software for colleges and universities
Sensor-based classroom and campus space utilization analytics for colleges and universities
researched.notes: Given URL www.quodus.ai does not resolve; canonical host is quodus.ai. Only address on the site is 'Quodus Inc., The Green STE B, Dover, Delaware' which is a registered-agent address, not an operating HQ, so hq_location omitted. Customer references are European (University of West Timisoara, Loyola). No founding year found on site.

researched.description: Cloud platform for financial, risk and sustainability reporting and compliance across all industries
researched.notes: Horizontal enterprise reporting/GRC platform; government and higher education are two of many listed industries alongside banking, investments, insurance and energy. Founded as WebFilings LLC in 2008.

researched.description: Text-based pet training and behavior support subscription for animal shelters, rescues and their adopters and fosters
researched.notes: Judgment call worth a second look. The core deliverable is live human trainers answering adopter and foster texts five days a week, priced per pet, which reads as a tech-enabled service rather than a software product. There is a real software layer: a shelter dashboard, automated check-in messaging and integrations with Shelterluv, PetPoint, Chameleon, Animal Shelter Manager and others. If the owner counts tech-enabled services, this flips to govtech under General Gov / Citizen Services.

researched.description: Financial close, account reconciliation and intercompany accounting automation software for large enterprises
researched.notes: Horizontal accounting-automation SaaS sold across all industries; public sector is one vertical among many.

researched.description: Financial and operational data consolidation, reconciliation and governance platform for enterprises
researched.notes: Could not confirm this is the company that exhibited at GFOA. The site at datacognyx.com is a two-page brochure with no team, no customers, no founding year and no US presence; its only contact details are a South African phone number (+27) and an address at Waterfall Point Business Park, Midrand, South Africa. Searches for 'Datacognyx' returned no company records at all (only near-miss names such as Datacogin, dataCogence, Dataknox), and nothing tying the name to US municipal finance. Not found by these searches; a name collision or a very new entity are both possible.

researched.description: Cloud ERP for cities and counties covering finance, budgeting, utility billing, payroll, permitting, licensing and code enforcement, built on Oracle NetSuite
researched.notes: Founding year 2014 from Tracxn/Crustdata profiles; the company site names co-founders Paul Cammisa and Gary McTall but gives no founding date.

researched.description: Barcode and RFID fixed-asset and inventory tracking software for organizations across retail, manufacturing, healthcare, education and government
researched.notes: Horizontal asset-tracking SaaS; government and education are two of ten listed industries. Founded 2004 by David Bissonnette inside Strategic Systems & Technology, which formally acquired RedBeam in 2020.

researched.description: Investment, debt and cash management software for public agency treasurers and municipal finance offices
researched.notes: A division of Emphasys Software since a 2007 acquisition from JP Morgan Chase; still marketed under the SymPro brand with its own site and sales team.

researched.description: Two-sided marketplace where employers post hourly and entry-level jobs with upfront pay, benefits and commute data
researched.notes: Legal entity is Workwise Solutions Inc. Horizontal hourly-hiring marketplace whose stated focus is retail, hospitality, food service, warehousing and logistics; public sector employers are one buyer type among many. Site lists no HQ or founding year; Brooklyn and 2022 come from Crunchbase/TechCrunch funding coverage.

researched.description: BOSS business operations software covering CRM, bidding, ordering, inventory, billing and accounting for landscaping, field service, marine and food service companies
researched.notes: Candidate was listed as 'BOSS by Integra'; BOSS is the product, The Integra Group is the company. Their food service page lists 'K-12 options' as one module feature, which is presumably the SNA angle, but the site names no government or school district customers and the other verticals are all private industry. Address is a PO Box in Manchester, MO. No founding year on site.

researched.description: Commercial off-the-shelf software for state government agencies covering grant management, unemployment insurance tax audit and child nutrition program administration
researched.notes: Product line spans three sectors: GMS grant management for state education agencies, COMPAS UI Tax Audit and UI BAM for state labor departments, and Harvest for state child nutrition programs. Filed under General Gov / Finance & ERP because grant and fund administration is the flagship; the owner may prefer to split or re-file it.

researched.description: Power market forecasting, resource planning, asset valuation and storage bid optimization software for utilities and energy developers
researched.notes: Sector-specific to power, not horizontal, so not scope_review. Worth knowing that the customer base extends well beyond public power utilities to independent power producers, developers, corporates and financial institutions, and that the company also runs a sizable consulting practice alongside the software.

researched.description: On-vehicle AI that detects potholes and other road hazards in real time and feeds a road maintenance dashboard and API for city and state road authorities
researched.notes: Candidate had no URL; dareesoft.com confirmed as the company site. Korean company founded January 2020 with a US subsidiary, Dareesoft North America Inc., at 1730 Minor Ave Suite 1050, Seattle, WA. Public sector references include Seoul, Seongnam, Sejong, NYC DOT and Brazoria County, Texas.

researched.description: Enterprise legal management, legal spend and contract lifecycle software for corporate legal departments
researched.notes: Candidate had no URL; onit.com confirmed. Horizontal corporate legal-ops vendor: the site lists Government alongside Pharmaceutical, Finance, Insurance and Technology as industries. Category is a stretch - the map has no general 'legal department' bucket, and municipal law offices are the plausible IMLA buyer.

researched.description: EHR and case management software for PACE programs, State Units on Aging, Area Agencies on Aging and community-based aging services organizations
researched.notes: Formed in October 2024 by Assured Healthcare Partners from three merged businesses - RTZ Systems, PeerPlace Networks and Tabula Rasa's PACE EMR division (TruChart, PACELogic). The site says 'three decades strong' and PitchBook lists 1990, which is the RTZ predecessor; 2024 is the founding of Collabrios Health itself. HQ from PitchBook, not the site.

researched.description: Contract security guard, facility services and electronic offender monitoring services for corporate and government clients
researched.notes: Electronic monitoring is one service line inside a very large manned-guarding and facility-services firm, not a standalone software product company. Formed August 2016 by the merger of AlliedBarton and Universal Services of America; dual headquarters in Conshohocken, PA and Irvine, CA.

researched.description: Case management, drug testing lab management and participant supervision software for treatment courts, probation and pretrial agencies
researched.notes: Claims courts in 46 states. No address, leadership page or founding year anywhere on the site; support contact routes to dims@datagainservices.com with a Kentucky 606 area code, suggesting a tie to Datagain, but nothing on the site confirms an HQ so the field is omitted. Product mix includes hardware (Sure Digital Cup, React breathalyzer) alongside the software.

researched.description: Design, engineering and BIM software including water and civil infrastructure modeling tools, sold across architecture, construction, manufacturing and media
researched.notes: Horizontal design-software vendor; the AWWA presence is the water infrastructure product line (Info360, InfoWorks ICM via the Innovyze acquisition), not a government-specific business. autodesk.com blocks automated fetches with an Akamai 403; classification is from the company's public product and corporate information.
